notionVersion.description: The [API version](/reference/versioning) to use for this request. The latest version is `2026-03-11`.
notionVersion.name: Notion-Version

card_layout.description: Card layout mode (list shows all properties, compact shows inline).

group_by.description: Column (horizontal) grouping - required for board view.

properties.description: Properties to display on each card.

date_property_id.description: Date property used to position items on the calendar - required.

properties.description: Properties to display on calendar event cards.

aggregator.description: The aggregation operator. "count" counts all rows and does not require a property_id. All other operators require a property_id.

property_id.description: The property to aggregate on. Required for all operators except "count".

dash_style.description: Line style: "solid" for a continuous line, "dash" for a dashed line.

id.description: Unique identifier for the reference line.

label.description: Label displayed alongside the reference line.

value.description: The y-axis value where the reference line is drawn.

caption.description: Text caption displayed below the chart. Null when no caption is shown.

chart_type.description: The chart type: column (vertical bars), bar (horizontal bars), line, donut, or number (single value display).

color_by_value.description: Whether chart elements are colored by their numeric value (gradient coloring).

cumulative.description: Whether to show cumulative values (line charts only).

donut_labels.description: What to display on donut chart slices.

group_style.description: How grouped/stacked bars are displayed. "normal" stacks values, "percent" normalizes to 100%, "side_by_side" places bars next to each other.

hide_empty_groups.description: Whether to hide groups with no data on the x-axis.

hide_line_fill_area.description: Whether to hide the shaded area under the line (line charts only).

hide_title.description: Whether to hide the title label (number charts only).

legend_position.description: Legend display position. "off" hides the legend.

reference_lines.description: Reference lines drawn on the chart. Null when no reference lines are configured.

show_data_labels.description: Whether to show data value labels on chart elements.

smooth_line.description: Whether to use smooth curves (line charts only).

stack_by.description: Stack-by grouping configuration for stacked/grouped bar charts (column/bar/line only). Null when not stacked.

value.description: Aggregation configuration for number charts (single value display).

x_axis.description: X-axis grouping configuration for column/bar/line/donut charts using grouped data. Null when using results (raw property values) mode.

x_axis_property_id.description: Property ID for the x-axis name values when using results (raw property values) mode.

y_axis.description: Y-axis aggregation for column/bar/line/donut charts using grouped data. Null when using results mode.

y_axis_max.description: Custom maximum value for the y-axis. Null clears the override.

y_axis_min.description: Custom minimum value for the y-axis. Null clears the override.

y_axis_property_id.description: Property ID for the y-axis numeric values when using results (raw property values) mode.

hide_empty_groups.description: Whether to hide groups that have no items.

sort.description: Sort order for groups (only manual for checkbox).

height.description: Fixed height of the row in pixels.

id.description: The ID of this row module.

widgets.description: The widget modules within this row.

rows.description: The rows that make up the dashboard layout. Each row contains one or more widget modules.

id.description: The ID of this widget module.

row_index.description: The 0-based index of the row this widget belongs to. Widgets in the same row share the same row_index.

view_id.description: The ID of the collection view rendered by this widget.

width.description: Width of the widget in a 12-column grid (1-12). 12 means full width.

created_by.description: The user who created the view, or null if not available.

created_time.description: The time when the view was created.

dashboard_view_id.description: For dashboard widget views, the ID of the parent dashboard view. Only present when this view is a widget inside a dashboard.

data_source_id.description: The ID of the data source this view is scoped to, or null for dashboard views.

filter.description: The filter applied to this view (same shape as data source query filter).

last_edited_by.description: The user who last edited the view, or null if not available.

last_edited_time.description: The time when the view was last edited.

parent.description: The parent database of the view.

quick_filters.description: Quick filters pinned to the view's filter bar. Keys are property IDs. Values are filter conditions (same shape as a property filter without the property field). Null when no quick filters are set.

sorts.description: The sorts applied to this view (same shape as data source query sorts).

url.description: Canonical deep link to the view in Notion.

database_id.description: The ID of the parent database.

hide_empty_groups.description: Whether to hide groups that have no items.

sort.description: Sort order for groups (no manual sort for dates).

start_day_of_week.description: Start day of week for week grouping (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday).

is_form_closed.description: Whether the form is closed for submissions.

submission_permissions.description: Permission level granted to the submitter on the created page after form submission.

type.description: The formula result type for grouping.

map_by.description: Property ID of the location property used to position items on the map.

quickFilterConditionResponse.description: A property filter condition. Same shape as a property filter but without the "property" field. For example: { "select": { "equals": "High" } }.

group_by.description: How to group status values. "group" groups by status group (To Do/In Progress/Done), "option" groups by individual option.

hide_empty_groups.description: Whether to hide groups that have no items.

display_mode.description: How sub-items are displayed. "show" renders hierarchically with toggles, "hidden" shows parents with a count, "flattened" shows sub-items with a parent indicator, "disabled" turns off sub-item rendering.

filter_scope.description: Which items are included when filtering. "parents" includes parent items only, "parents_and_subitems" includes both, "subitems" includes sub-items only.

property_id.description: Relation property ID used for parent-child nesting.

toggle_column_id.description: Property ID of the column showing the sub-item expand/collapse toggle.

frozen_column_index.description: Index of the last frozen column. Columns up to and including this index are frozen.

properties.description: Columns/properties visible in the table view.

show_vertical_lines.description: Whether to show vertical lines between columns.

wrap_cells.description: Whether to wrap cell content by default.

hide_empty_groups.description: Whether to hide groups that have no items.

property_id.description: Relation property ID used for dependency arrows.

center_timestamp.description: Center timestamp for the timeline view (Unix timestamp in ms).

color_by.description: Whether to color-code items by property.

end_date_property_id.description: End date property (optional, for items that span a range).

properties.description: Properties to display on timeline items.

show_table.description: Whether to show the table panel alongside the timeline.

table_properties.description: Properties to display in the table panel (when show_table is true).

viewConfigResponse.description: View configuration, typed by view type (table, board, calendar, etc.).

viewFilterResponse.description: Filter for the view. Can be a property filter (filter by property value), timestamp filter (filter by created_time or last_edited_time), or compound filter (combine filters with and/or logic). Compound filters support up to 2 levels of nesting.

oneOf.description: A filter condition on a specific property. The property field specifies which property to filter, and an additional field specifies the filter type and condition (e.g., title, rich_text, number, checkbox, select, multi_select, date, people, files, relation, formula, rollup, etc.).

property.description: The name or ID of the property to filter on.

oneOf.description: A filter condition on a timestamp (created_time or last_edited_time). The timestamp field specifies which timestamp, and a matching field contains the date filter condition.

date_format.description: Date display format (date properties only). "full" = localized full date, "short" = month and day, "month_day_year" = MM/DD/YYYY, "day_month_year" = DD/MM/YYYY, "year_month_day" = YYYY/MM/DD, "relative" = relative dates.

property_name.description: Property name (convenience field, not stable across renames).

status_show_as.description: How to display status properties (as select dropdown or checkbox).

time_format.description: Time display format (date properties only). "12_hour" = 12-hour clock with AM/PM, "24_hour" = 24-hour clock, "hidden" = hide time.

wrap.description: Whether to wrap content in this property cell/card.
